title: Thermodynamic topology of AdS black holes with $F^{αβ}F^{γλ}R_{αγ}R_{βλ}$ coupling in the grand canonical ensemble
summary: We investigate the thermodynamic and topological phase structure of charged AdS black holes with a nonminimal gauge--curvature coupling in the grand canonical ensemble. In the minimal-coupling limit $ε=0$, the system exhibits only Hawking--Page-like behavior and does not possess van der Waals criticality. Working perturbatively in the nonminimal coupling, we find that the $ε\neq0$ interaction generates a rich phase structure as the electric potential is varied, including several distinct regimes of critical behavior, a double-critical region, and a regime where conventional criticality…
